sn36.23:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn36.23:1.2: katamā nu kho bhante vedanā katamo vedanāsamudayo katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā
sn36.23:1.4: ko vedanāya assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
sn36.23:2.2: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
sn36.23:2.7: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn36.23:2.9: yaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ayaṃ vedanāya assādo.
sn36.23:2.10: yā vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayaṃ vedanāya ādīnavo.
sn36.23:2.11: yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇanti.
